answer.text: Total overdue AR is about NZD 10.17 million. AU-EAST has the most at NZD 3.58m, then NZ-NORTH at 3.08m, AU-WEST at 1.79m and NZ-SOUTH at 1.71m.
assumptions: Outstanding NZD on invoices past their due date, as at today, with no time range applied.
AUD converted to NZD at the monthly rate.
The total is the sum of the four regions.

sql.sql:
select i.region as region, round(sum(i.outstanding_nzd) filter (where i.days_overdue > 0), 2) as ar_overdue_amount
from marts.fct_invoices as i
group by 1
order by 2 desc nulls last
limit %(row_limit)s
